title: Ode of the Devourer
start: Check on Bill at the Fort Forinthry workshop.

recommended.t: A quick way to reach fairy rings

kills.l: Shadowsands feline akh (Ode of the Devourer)
Shadowsands gorilla akh (Ode of the Devourer)

rewards.t: 50000 Mining XP lamp (Skill must be level 60 or higher)
rewards.l: Mining XP lamp (Ode of the Devourer)

rewards.t: 50000 Agility XP lamp (Skill must be level 60 or higher)
rewards.l: Agility XP lamp (Ode of the Devourer)

rewards.t: 50000 Divination XP lamp (Skill must be level 60 or higher)
rewards.l: Divination XP lamp (Ode of the Devourer)

rewards.t: 50000 Crafting XP lamp (Skill must be level 60 or higher)
rewards.l: Crafting XP lamp (Ode of the Devourer)

rewards.t: Access to the Gate of Elidinis skilling boss.

steps.t: Read note on the cabbage dummy at Fort Forinthry's Workshop. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre to the south-east. [Chat: 2 Talk about quests.]
Continue with the Ode of the Devourer portal west of the Al Kharid lodestone. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Kill the feline akhs near the following civilians, then save them by fully finishing their dialogue:

sub.t: Ali Morrisane, south of Ranael's Super Skirt Store.
Ayesha, north of the tanner's building.
Zeke, between three tents, east of the silk stall.

steps.t: Crawl under the cart south of the Al Kharid bank.
Kill the feline akh.
Talk to Bill.
Head to the City of Um northern docks.
Take the gondola that's located next to where the Suspicious Stranger was sitting.
Continue with the Ode of the Devourer portal outside the Sanctum of Rebirth. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Icthlarin. [Chat: 4 Continue Quest.]
Enter the floor hatch in Fort Forinthry (outside the eastern wall of the Command Centre). [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Zemouregal. [Chat: 1 Find the idol of Amascut.]

Continue with the Ode of the Devourer portal south-west of the Kalphite Hive (Fairy code BIQ). [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 What's he talking about? › 2 Not much. Tell me the abridged version. › 3 Continue Conversation.]

Continue with the Ode of the Devourer portal outside Al Kharid's north-eastern entrance by the Het's Oasis. If the game is bugging out and there is green fog everywhere then change the skybox. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Father Salman just north of Zeke's Superior Scimitars.
Talk to Ali Morrisane north-east. [Chat: 2 Look for a different option.]
Walk five game squares away.
Talk to Zemouregal.
Talk to any 5 citizens around the city with an option to spread rumours about Ali Morrisane. [Chat: 1 Spread rumours about Ali Morrisane.]
Talk to Ali Morrisane.
Talk to Father Salman.
If you haven't completed Ritual of the Mahjarrat:

sub.t: Talk to Zemouregal. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Ode of the Devourer'. › 1 Travel to the ritual site.]

steps.t: If you have completed Ritual of the Mahjarrat:

sub.t: Use fairy ring DKQ to travel to the Glacor Cave, leave via the exit to the north-east, then run north-west.
Continue with the Ode of the Devourer portal near the ritual marker. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

steps.t: Talk to Icthlarin. [Chat: 3 Continue Conversation.]
Search the north-western and south-eastern forgotten warriors.
Talk to Zemouregal.
Use the absorption rune on the ritual marker twice.
Use the ceremonial dagger on the ritual marker to receive Shard of the Gate. [Chat: 1 Do it.]
Talk to Zemouregal.
Carry an almost empty backpack and your best mining equipment, plus 10 pieces of food and a beast of burden.

sub.t: Optionally follow The Gate of Elidinis strategy article for help on gear setup.

steps.t: Continue with the Ode of the Devourer portal outside the Sanctum of Rebirth. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Icthlarin.
Receive blessing on the idol of Amascut or the shard of the Gate.
Enter The Gate of Elidinis stream.
Cleanse The Gate of Elidinis.

sub.t: Begin the encounter. Staying south of the moonstone conduits will make learning The Gate of Elidinis encounter easier.

Gather 25-40 moonstone fragments from nearby moonstone outcrops. Moonstone fragments provide 10% barrier strength per repair action on any of the moonstone conduits. Moonstone fragments also deal 7,500 damage per throw to summoned feline akhs by clicking on the feline akhs.

Repair any of the moonstone conduits located in the middle of the encounter with moonstone fragments until the barrier's strength reaches at least 30%. Staying south of the moonstone conduits will use their barrier strength to reduce the damage taken from each "Begone!" mechanic proportional to the barrier's strength. This mechanic also depletes up to 30% of the barriers strength.
Transmute any corrupt shard of Elidinis until it becomes a cleansed shard of Elidinis. Transmuting adds corruption stacks which increases the damage the player takes over time in the encounter.
Mine the cleansed shard of Elidinis to obtain cleansed statue shards.

Activate the action button once 10+ cleansed statue shards have been collected to ask Icthlarin for aid. This will spawn pillars to help the player jump up to The Gate of Elidinis, consuming all the cleansed statue shards on them and applying a damage bonus depending on how quick the player performed all the jumps. Corruption stacks decrease by the amount of cleansed statue shards consumed with the jump.

Stand within Icthlarin's protective shield after performing all the jumps. Icthlarin's shield will mitigate the incoming attack. The attack also depletes all the barrier strength from the moonstone conduits.

Keep collecting cleansed statue shards by transmuting corrupt shards of Elidinis and mining cleansed shards of Elidinis, using the action button as needed, repairing the moonstone conduits as needed, and clicking on summoned feline akhs to throw moonstone fragments at them.

steps.t: Carry your highest level combat equipment, food and potions.
Proceed through the cutscene. [Chat: 3 Meow.]
Kill the four waves of monsters.

sub.t: Pray against melee. The easiest way to beat this is to stay close to Icthlarin constantly, and attack the monsters that come near you.
Stay inside the green barrier to avoid instant kills occurring when the timer at the top runs out.

steps.t: Proceed through the dialogue. [Chat: 3 We all got what we wanted.]
Talk to Zemouregal. [Chat: 2 Send Zemouregal to the Fort Forinthry Prison.]
Enter the floor hatch in Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Bill.
Quest complete!
